evals.prompt: The spec asks for a scroll story on the landing page. The developer reaches for a window scroll listener and GSAP from CDN.
evals.expected_output: Uses ScrollTrigger inside a gsap.context with revert on teardown, animations on transform/opacity only, reduced-motion branch, and the package from the project's own dependencies (no CDN).

evals.prompt: A hero three.js scene loads a 6 MB GLB synchronously and delays first paint.
evals.expected_output: Lazy-loads the canvas with a poster fallback, compresses the asset (Draco/Meshopt), clamps DPR, pauses off-screen and keeps the first render free of the 3D bundle.

evals.prompt: A review FIX round says the mobile menu spacing is uneven and the accent color fails contrast on the surface background.
evals.expected_output: Applies only the requested changes, moves the spacing to the token scale, adjusts the accent token to pass 4.5:1, and appends one History line before completing the card.
